context:
Goal: batch runner 8 does every child-repo merge.
Problem (rule): auto mode in runner 8's chat blocks its merges because your merge grant was never said in that chat, so each merge waits on you.
Based on (ruling): your 17:37 CST grant: mark ready, merge and review in all your repos.
Based on (ruling): your 21:34 CST roster: batch runners run every merge; the coordinator never merges.

options.gain: Future runners need nothing from you.

options.lose: Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo. A lasting widening in every session.

title: Batch runner 8 can't merge: put your grant in its chat, or add an allow line?
